tagline: Your Reserve. Right in the Heart of Thomson.
projectDesc: Thomson Reserve is a 99-year leasehold development in District 20 by UOL Group, Singapore Land & CapitaLand. ~1,240 units at Bright Hill Drive, next to Upper Thomson MRT Station and directly opposite Thomson Plaza. Targeted preview Oct 2026.
locationDesc: Thomson Reserve sits next to Upper Thomson MRT Station (TEL), walkable today. The upcoming Bright Hill MRT interchange (TEL/CRL) connects you to a powerful cross-island network. Directly opposite, Thomson Plaza provides everyday convenience — while AMK Hub and Junction 8 are minutes away, and the Orchard and CBD corridor is in direct reach on the Thomson–East Coast Line.
lifestyleDesc: Step outside to Upper Thomson's vibrant dining village — a delightful mix of local flavours and global tastes. Thomson Plaza sits directly opposite for everyday shopping and dining. Singapore Island Country Club offers premier golfing and recreational experiences, while Bishan-Ang Mo Kio Park and four other nature parks — Lower Peirce Reservoir, Windsor Nature Park, MacRitchie Reservoir Park, and Thomson Nature Park — put lush greenery right at your doorstep.
overviewDesc: Thomson Reserve rises from the landmark $810 million en bloc acquisition of Thomson View Condominium — one of the most highly anticipated collective sales in recent history. Sitting on a sprawling 5-hectare estate with a land cost of $1,178 psf/ppr, this is a rare RCR development priced below OCR land rates. Backed by three blue-chip developers — UOL Group, Singapore Land & CapitaLand — it delivers over 1,200 residences of considered design in one of Singapore's most coveted growth corridors.
developerDesc: The consortium behind Thomson Reserve — UOL Group, Singapore Land & CapitaLand — has delivered some of Singapore's most celebrated residential addresses: Skye At Holland, Parktown Residences, UPPERHOUSE at Orchard Boulevard, Meyer Blue, Watten House, and Lyndenwoods. Their combined expertise ensures premium design, efficient layouts, and long-term value for homeowners.
